name: Nuclear risk
summary: Kim Jong Un calls for wider deployment of low-yield battlefield nuclear weapons on 25 Nov; no US–Russia treaty limits
state: KCNA said Kim Jong Un inspected two nuclear material production plants, one new and one expanding, and on 25 Nov called for deploying low-yield battlefield nuclear weapons in diverse areas (AP via KPBS; Korea Times). IAEA chief Rafael Grossi called the expansion of enrichment at Yongbyon a serious concern (AP via KPBS). No nuclear test, alert-level change or threatened use in an active conflict was found to 27 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: No direct change for the public. In any nuclear emergency in the UK, follow official guidance from government and emergency services.
rubric_hit: Explicit expansion and deployment rhetoric; no test or alert change

sources.title: KPBS (AP) — North Korea's Kim vows to build more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump's overture
Korea Times (Yonhap) — NK leader stresses use of tactical nukes in diverse areas

why: Nuclear use anywhere would be a civilisational shock; arms-control treaties are weaker than at any time since the 1960s.
drivers: Threats in active wars, testing, doctrine changes, arms-control collapse, proliferation.

rubric.alert: A nuclear test, changes in deployment/alert levels, or threatened use in an active conflict.
rubric.watch: Explicit threats, unusual exercises, doctrine changes, or arms-control lapses without replacement.
rubric.normal: No explicit nuclear threats or tests; arms-control dialogue active.
